events.title: A new version of the nasty saleswoman
events.summary: We have a new version of the nasty saleswoman ready. You might have thought her outfit looked a bit ridiculous—well, you weren’t imagining things. That was exactly the intention! You’ll be able to uncover the secret behind the creator’s vision in the next chapter!

events.title: Participation in the "Steam Next Fest"
events.summary: Starting tomorrow (October 19) and running through Monday (October 26), the visual novel "Remedy for Personality" will be featured in the "Steam Next Fest" (a festival dedicated to game demos). If you haven't played the first chapter of our visual novel yet, now is the perfect time to do so!

events.title: New Eva Sprites
events.summary: We're continuing to work on the new chapter. Today, we'll be presenting a sportier version of the red-haired beast. Now Eva looks even more interesting. Yes, after a short break, we've decided to go all-out. You're probably wondering what these sprites were for? For fan service the exciting gym scene, of course. I won't spoil its content, but I will spoil my impressions: the scene, in my humble opinion, was absolutely smashing.

events.title: Work on Regina's updated sprites is complete
events.summary: Work on Chapter 2 continues. We've now completed Regina's updated sprites. Even though the next chapter won't feature many characters, there's still a lot of work to do.

events.title: Development of the second chapter
events.summary: Well... it's been a while since we've heard any news. After the release of the updated demo, a lot of effort was spent trying to promote the novella. It was primarily promoted through streamers. Many people agreed to share their thoughts on our story live, for which we're extremely grateful.
